evidence.title: Situational Awareness, star AI hedge fund that nearly imploded, now being probed by the SEC

summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has opened an investigation into Situational Awareness, a prominent AI-driven hedge fund that recently faced a near‑collapse. Regulators are examining the fund’s trading practices and risk controls following reports of severe financial distress.
title: SEC Launches Probe into AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Amid Near Collapse
